title: Metal Vs Wood Vs PVC NFC Business Cards
summary: Material choice for NFC business cards changes more than the visual finish. It affects brand perception, production practicality and how the card fits the intended user group.
heroPoints: Metal fits premium executive or luxury-led programs.
Wood fits sustainability or boutique positioning when the finish is part of the story.
imageAlt: Metal, wood and PVC NFC business cards

rows: Team-wide rollouts and standard business-card programs
Strong perceived value and distinct look
Needs tighter control over finish and construction
Eco-led, boutique and tactile brand programs
Material consistency and finish choice matter more

sections.title: What should decide after material
sections.intro: The material is only one decision. The team still needs to agree on chip behavior, redirect workflow and whether personalization is required across multiple users.
bullets: Confirm phone compatibility and redirect behavior first.
Then decide whether premium material meaningfully improves the brand outcome.
Use packaging and personalization requirements to refine the sample set.

faq.question: Is metal the best option for all premium NFC card projects?
faq.answer: No. Metal fits some premium programs well, but wood or even carefully finished PVC can be better if the brand story or rollout model points elsewhere.

faq.question: Should teams decide on material before workflow?
faq.answer: No. The tap behavior, target phones and redirect logic should be confirmed first so the material decision supports the actual use case.
